scenario: Interpolation takes bound paths (LEXP.9.3.1): a `log` string with two of them, `"{e.entity_id}: {e.qty} events"`, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no message is rendered.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    qty: Int mutable

rule r:
    Event e
->
    log info "{e.entity_id}: {e.qty} events"
